title: Compatibility with the prescribed derived marking
statement: theorem exists_marking_compatible_finiteFree_lift {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R) (hnil : ∃ N : ℕ, 1 ≤ N ∧ I ^ N = 0) (hunits : ∀ x : I, IsUnit (1 + (x : R))) [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)] [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))] (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))) (ε : DerivedCategory.Qh ⋙ L ⟶ @Functor.mapHomotopyCategory _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).left_adjoint_additive (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh) [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor ε (HomotopyCategory.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) (.up ℤ))] (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)) (hK : IsPseudoCoherent K) (F : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I)) ℤ) (b : ℤ) (hFbound : F.IsStrictlyLE b) (hFterms : ∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free (R ⧸ I) (F.X i) ∧ Module.Finite (R ⧸ I) (F.X i)) (α : L.obj K ≅ Q.obj F) (hdata : ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (β : Q.obj P ≅ K) (θ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ≅ F), P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free R (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (P.X i))) : ∃ (P : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{max u v} R) ℤ) (β : Q.obj P ≅ K) (θ : ((ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ≅ F), P.IsStrictlyLE b ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, Module.Free R (P.X i) ∧ Module.Finite R (P.X i)) ∧ L.map β.hom ≫ α.hom = L.map ((quotientCompQhIso (ModuleCat.{max u v} R)).inv.app P) ≫ ε.app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P) ≫ Qh.map ((@Functor.mapHomotopyCategoryFactors _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (ModuleCat.extendScalars (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)) (ModuleCat.extendRestrictScalarsAdj (Ideal.Quotient.mk I)).left_adjoint_additive (.up ℤ)).hom.app P) ≫ (quotientCompQhIso (ModuleCat.{max u v} (R ⧸ I))).hom.app _ ≫ Q.map θ.hom
